findings.issue: הִתְאַוּוּ is 3rd common plural. Singular codició breaks that agreement, so volvieron and lloraron read as acts of hijos de Israel alone; גם marks those sons as additional to the same plural subject.
H628 is one masculine collective (a gathered mixed company). mezcla can be heard as an abstract blend and thins that people-group sense.

notes: Cognate תאוה, גם, Israel, and hiphil אכל otherwise stay within the tokens.
